metadata.purpose: KHET-STAR KI NAMI item 4b benchmark -- real Sentinel-1 GRD query time and real pass availability, measured before wiring field_wetness_index_relative into cloudflare/mera_khet_worker.js. Same ~1.86 ha test polygon near Bhopal, MP that docs/MERA_KHET_BENCHMARK.json's A3 benchmark used, for direct comparability.
metadata.note: Real numbers only -- a query that fails or times out is reported as a failure, not papered over with an estimate. Revisit-frequency claims below are from this repo's own live query at this exact point, not assumed from Copernicus's idealized global figure.

benchmarks.label: 1_pass_count_30d
benchmarks.finding: Only 1 real Sentinel-1 scene intersecting this exact point in the last 30 days -- meaningfully worse than an idealized '6-day combined revisit' figure would suggest.

benchmarks.label: 2_pass_count_60d
benchmarks.finding: Irregular real gaps of 7, 12, and 24 days between consecutive scenes -- not the idealized 6-12 day figure. Explanation: this window (2026-06-14 to 2026-08-13) straddles Sentinel-1A's documented end-of-life (Copernicus SentiWiki, fetched 2026-08-13: 'Sentinel-1A: scheduled for end-of-life by end of June 2026') during the transition to the Sentinel-1C/1D pair ('Sentinel-1C: fully operational since May 2025', 'Sentinel-1D: fully operational starting mid April 2026'). This is why buildS1WetnessExpression() uses a 60-day (not narrower) lookback window -- verified necessary from this real gap data, not an arbitrary choice.

benchmarks.label: 4_district_backscatter_same_scene
benchmarks.note: Same COPERNICUS/S1_GRD image as benchmark 3, reduceRegion'd over Bhopal district's real FAO/GAUL/2015/level2 polygon instead of the field polygon -- confirms the 'same acquisition, two regions' comparison is real and computable, not just field-only.
